result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but there are a few minor issues: the third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off (expected for a carousel but text truncation may look awkward), and some placeholder-style illustrations appear on restaurant cards. No critical problems detected.

issues.description: Third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' is partially cut off at the right edge, with its name truncated mid-word without an ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles truncate with an ellipsis or use a peek indicator so users understand the carousel is scrollable

issues.description: The promo banner '3 free deliveries for you' has a decorative circle shape overlapping the right edge, which slightly crowds the text area
issues.suggestion: Reposition the decorative element or add padding so the content area remains visually balanced

issues.description: The fourth filter chip at the far right of the category row is cut off with no visible indication that more filters exist
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or partial chip peek to signal horizontal scrollability
